notifications.answer: Agent done, question and error events raise notifications and sounds.

claims.answer: Built-in agent plus external Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode sessions through ACP, and a long list of model providers including custom endpoints.

claims.answer: Subscriptions through Claude Code login, ChatGPT login via Codex, and imported coding plans; own API keys; local models; no vendor account needed, while stagewise Cloud Inference credits are being sunset.

claims.answer: Download the app, complete onboarding (providers, skills, theme), mount a folder and chat; git is optional, and there is no managed-cloud or VPS path.

evidence.title: stagewise-io/stagewise repository
evidence.finding: Main repository for the stagewise agentic IDE: 6,836 stars on 2026-11-16, AGPL-3.0 per GitHub, default branch main, not archived.

evidence.title: stagewise README at pinned commit
evidence.locator: sections About, Use your coding subscription, stagewise Account (sunset), License
evidence.finding: Describes an open source agentic IDE with built-in coding agent, browser, BYO keys, listed subscription/provider imports, an account-service sunset at end of November 2026, and AGPLv3 licensing with contact for other uses.

evidence.title: Say Hello to Klex Bots (news post)
evidence.locator: sections Why we are building Klex Bots; What changes for stagewise
evidence.finding: Dated 2026-10-28. Says local agents cannot work 24/7, the team mostly halted work on stagewise, stagewise IDE accounts are being sunset (BYO keys needed after November 2026) and bug fixes continue for the foreseeable future.

evidence.title: stagewise browser app changelog
evidence.finding: 1.29.0 added external coding agent integrations (ACP), chat archiving and provider usage limits; 1.31.0 removed account-first onboarding; 1.31.1 (2026-11-04) is the pinned release.

evidence.title: stagewise pricing
evidence.finding: Hobby free with limited access to three models; Individual $20/month (Pro and Ultra grouped) with all models and extra credits; Enterprise custom with SSO (OIDC, SAML), SCIM and optional self-hosted stagewise Cloud. No annual option or credit amounts stated.

evidence.title: stagewise homepage
evidence.finding: Positions stagewise as an agentic IDE and agent orchestrator running locally; stagewise Account gives preconfigured Cloud Inference; BYOK and custom endpoints supported; open source AGPLv3; no download links or docs on the page.

evidence.title: stagewise privacy policy (repo copy)
evidence.locator: sections Customer Content, AI Model Interaction, Usage and Analytics, sub-processors, Data Retention
evidence.finding: Effective 2026-03-09. Customer content processed ephemerally; multimodal assets stored up to 72 hours in AWS S3; requests routed through Vercel AI Gateway to named inference providers without a zero-retention guarantee; PostHog EU analytics is opt-in.

evidence.title: GNU AGPL v3 license file
evidence.finding: Repository license is GNU Affero General Public License version 3 (no stated later-version grant in the file).

evidence.title: Electron Forge config
evidence.locator: makers array: MakerSquirrel, MakerRpm, MakerDeb, MakerDMG, MakerZIP
evidence.finding: Desktop installers are built for Windows (Squirrel setup.exe), Linux (deb, rpm) and macOS (DMG, ZIP).

evidence.title: Browser release workflow
evidence.locator: matrix: macos-26 arm64, macos-26-intel x64, ubuntu-latest x64, windows-latest x64
evidence.finding: Release builds cover macOS arm64 and x64, Linux x64 and Windows x64 only; no mobile or web artifact is produced.

evidence.title: Repository AGENTS.md
evidence.finding: Monorepo layout: apps/browser (Electron main product), apps/stagewise-cli (headless host for extracted agent packages), apps/deprecated-cli (legacy v0.12), website, update-server, agent-core and agent-shell packages. Product is an Electron app.

evidence.title: Provider type registry
evidence.finding: Registers stagewise cloud, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Moonshot, Alibaba, DeepSeek, Z.ai, MiniMax, Xiaomi MiMo, Mistral, xAI, coding-plan, custom Anthropic/OpenAI/Google endpoints, Azure, Bedrock, Vertex, Ollama, OpenRouter, codex, codex-stagewise, claude-code and opencode provider types.

evidence.title: ACP adapter registry
evidence.finding: External coding agents are driven through Agent Client Protocol adapters; the registry contains exactly codex, claude-code and opencode.

evidence.title: Claude Code ACP adapter
evidence.finding: Launches the user-installed claude executable through the bundled Claude agent ACP adapter; errors if claude is not installed or signed in; ask permissions map from the approval mode.

evidence.title: Codex ChatGPT auth reader
evidence.finding: Reads the Codex CLI auth.json ChatGPT access token so the built-in stagewise agent can use a ChatGPT subscription via the Codex responses endpoint; asks the user to run codex login first.

evidence.title: codex-stagewise harness
evidence.finding: Sends built-in-agent requests to chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex with the user ChatGPT bearer token and a Codex CLI originator header.

evidence.title: Coding plan definitions
evidence.finding: Defines imported provider coding plans (Qwen, MiniMax and others) that unlock a vendor model list with one API key.

evidence.title: Ollama provider type
evidence.finding: Local Ollama server models are discoverable as a provider type; custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints also exist.

evidence.title: Shared types and preferences schema
evidence.finding: Users hold a list of provider instances (several of the same type possible) and a privacy.telemetryLevel preference of off, anonymous or full defaulting to anonymous.

evidence.title: GitService
evidence.finding: The app creates, lists, switches and removes git worktrees and branches itself and detects merged targets; failures include not-git-repo.

evidence.title: Git service types
evidence.finding: Defines worktree and branch result types and the not-git-repo failure reason, so non-git folders are handled as a distinct case.

evidence.title: Chat panel footer worktree controls
evidence.finding: The chat footer lets a user prepare a new worktree or branch or switch to an existing worktree before sending work.

evidence.title: Worktree setup runner
evidence.finding: Runs a per-project worktree setup script (and detected Codex setup) when a worktree is created.

evidence.title: Global skills mounts
evidence.finding: Skills are mounted from ~/.stagewise/skills, ~/.agents/skills and optionally ~/.codex/skills and ~/.claude/skills; workspace skills come from .stagewise/skills and .agents/skills.

evidence.title: Workspace AGENTS.md reader
evidence.finding: Reads the workspace-root AGENTS.md into the agent context with a length cap.

evidence.title: Bundled plugins and skills
evidence.finding: Bundled plugins: figma, github, javascript-sandbox, mini-apps, posthog, remotion, supabase, vercel. Bundled skills: debug, implement, learn-skill, plan, preview, watch.

evidence.title: Plugin metadata schema
evidence.finding: Plugins are directories with metadata.json (name, description, required credential types) plus skills; credentials come from the product credential registry.

evidence.title: Credential type registry
evidence.finding: Credential types exist for GitHub, Figma, Vercel, Supabase, PostHog and Google AI personal access tokens used by plugins.

evidence.title: Internal stagewise MCP server
evidence.finding: The only MCP surface is a private stdio server handed to external ACP agents so they can show a native question form; no user MCP server configuration or exported control tools.

evidence.title: ACP runtime
evidence.finding: Session start passes only the internal stagewise MCP server and resumes persisted ACP sessions when the adapter supports it.

evidence.title: Agent memory persistence
evidence.finding: Chat history is written to per-agent memory snapshots (jsonl/markdown) on post-step, compression and message events, with a global memory index.

evidence.title: Plan markdown parsing
evidence.finding: Plans are markdown documents with a heading-derived name parsed into structured sections used by the plan viewer.

evidence.title: Agent persistence database
evidence.finding: Agent history, envelopes and approvals persist in a local libsql database, so chats reload after restart.

evidence.title: AgentManager
evidence.finding: Manages many agent instances at once, supports side chats cloned from a source chat, and exposes lifecycle notification hooks.

evidence.title: Tool approval modes
evidence.finding: Shell and sandbox tool approval modes are alwaysAsk (default), alwaysAllow and smart.

evidence.title: Smart approval classifier prompt
evidence.finding: In smart mode an LLM classifier decides whether a shell command needs approval, flagging out-of-workspace writes, global installs, outbound data, destructive git and privilege escalation.

evidence.title: Diff history spec
evidence.finding: Tracks per-agent file edits with before/after so changes can be reviewed and reverted from the chat.

evidence.title: Revert confirmation popover
evidence.finding: Chat messages offer a confirmed revert of the agent file changes made after that message.

evidence.title: BaseAgent
evidence.finding: Agents emit done, question and error events, queue user messages while busy, support maxSteps and maxRetries config and stop handling.

evidence.title: Notification sounds service
evidence.finding: Agent done, question and error events trigger desktop notification sounds.

evidence.title: Model fallback manager
evidence.finding: On upstream overload errors (429, 502, 503, 529) a preset advances to the next fallback model for 5 minutes.

evidence.title: Provider type interface
evidence.finding: Provider types can expose current subscription usage limits, shown in the app since 1.29.0; no per-task monetary cost is recorded.

evidence.title: TelemetryService
evidence.finding: Uses PostHog (EU host by default) gated by privacy.telemetryLevel; LLM tracing only at the full level.

evidence.title: Account settings telemetry control
evidence.finding: Settings expose a telemetry level control writing privacy.telemetryLevel.

evidence.title: stagewise-cli README
evidence.finding: MVP headless CLI mounts a workspace, sends one prompt to a chat agent and prints the answer; uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and alwaysAllow approvals.

evidence.title: stagewise-cli package.json
evidence.finding: Package @stagewise/stagewise-cli version 0.0.0 is marked private, so it is not published.

evidence.title: Deprecated CLI package.json
evidence.finding: The legacy npm stagewise-cli 0.12.0 is deprecated in favor of the desktop app.

evidence.title: Onboarding screens
evidence.finding: First run walks through provider configuration, skills and theme before use.

evidence.title: Shell tool directory
evidence.finding: The agent runs shell commands through a PTY-backed shell tool in the user environment.

evidence.title: Mount manager
evidence.locator: mounts with permissions, git worktree watcher
evidence.finding: Workspaces are mounted with permission flags and watched, including linked git worktrees.

evidence.title: JavaScript sandbox service
evidence.finding: A JS sandbox runs in an Electron utility process with mounted file access and diff capture; it is a scripting tool, not a container.

evidence.title: LSP service
evidence.finding: Language-server diagnostics feed a get-linting-diagnostics tool for the agent.

evidence.title: Library docs search tool
evidence.finding: The agent can list and search library documentation as external knowledge.

evidence.title: Browser tools
evidence.finding: The agent can read tab console logs and run sandboxed JS against browser tabs.

evidence.title: askUserQuestions tool
evidence.finding: The agent can pause to ask structured questions that the user answers in the UI.

evidence.title: Sidebar agents list
evidence.locator: agent list with archive/resume and worktree grouping
evidence.finding: The sidebar lists chats grouped by workspace/worktree with archive and resume actions.

evidence.title: URI handler
evidence.finding: Registers custom URL schemes only for authentication callbacks.

evidence.title: stagewise terms
evidence.finding: Terms of the hosted service and account.

evidence.title: Bundled GitHub plugin skill
evidence.locator: Capabilities list (issues, pull requests, actions, releases) and Making Requests section
evidence.finding: The product-bundled GitHub plugin skill tells the agent it can create, read, update and comment on issues, and create, list, review and merge pull requests through the GitHub REST API with a stored personal access token fetched inside the JS sandbox.

changes.author: agent:ADE-86
changes.summary: Independent review: bundled GitHub plugin skill documents creating, reviewing and merging pull requests and managing issues through a stored PAT, so the earlier 'no PR action' and 'no GitHub issue integration' answers were overstated.

before.answer: Branches and worktrees are product-managed; commits, PRs, CI and rebase are done by the agent through ordinary shell git/gh.

after.answer: Branches and worktrees are product-managed in the UI; commits and rebase run through ordinary shell git, and the bundled GitHub plugin skill lets the agent create, review, comment on and merge pull requests through the GitHub REST API with a user PAT (no dedicated PR UI).

lifecycle.note: The stagewise team announced it is sunsetting stagewise IDE accounts; after November 2026 users need their own subscription or API keys for another model provider.
lifecycle.scope: stagewise-hosted accounts and Cloud Inference models routed through them; not the open-source desktop application.
lifecycle.continuation: The AGPL-3.0 desktop ADE keeps working with bring-your-own subscriptions or API keys, and the team says it will keep shipping bug fixes and small improvements for the foreseeable future.
